prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [sign_in, hint] Existing Account Pet Recovery Callout: Add a clear account sync hint on the sign-in screen informing users that signing into their existing account restores previously created pets.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Sign in with your original account to automatically restore all your saved desktop pets."}}
1: [home, new_flow] Live Desktop Pet Generation Status Flow: Rebuild the waiting screen with a staged layout featuring real-time rendering progress updates and interactive tips.
   config: {"waiting": {"layout": "stage", "show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "notify_when_ready": true, "components": [{"type": "progress", "label": "Generating custom desktop pet companion...", "style": "highlight"}, {"type": "tip_carousel", "text": "Tips while your companion prepares", "style": "calm"}]}}
2: [adoption, redesign] Split Layout Customization Workspace: Redesign the companion pick screen into a split workspace layout separating companion selection choices from live pet preview components.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "split", "components": [{"type": "preview", "style": "rounded"}, {"type": "choice_cards", "style": "playful"}]}}
3: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Companion Interaction Onboarding Screen: Insert a dedicated onboarding screen prior to completion that demonstrates basic desktop pet controls, hiding shortcuts, and interaction commands.
   config: {"new_controls_intro": {"headline": "Mastering Your Desktop Companion", "body": "Right-click your pet anytime to access controls, send commands, or adjust visibility options.", "layout": "centered"}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_controls_intro", "home_intro"]}
4: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Adoption Sign-In Journey Reorder: Move sign-in after pet adoption and customization screens so users establish emotional investment before account setup.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
5: [home, wait_info] Pet Preparation Time Remaining Estimate: Display dynamic time remaining estimates and completion notifications during the desktop pet assembly process.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "Your desktop companion is being prepared. Estimated time: ~2 minutes."}}
6: [choose_path, layout] Spotlight Companion Path Selector: Update the path selection screen to a spotlight layout focusing attention on one companion onboarding journey at a time.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "spotlight", "show_step_counter": true}}
7: [adoption, copy] Clear Photo Upload Requirement Instructions: Provide clear copy on photo upload guidelines explaining lighting and framing for accurate pet model generation.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"headline": "Upload Clear Pet Photos for Best Results", "body": "Use well-lit, front-facing photos so our system can accurately render your custom desktop pet model."}}
8: [finish, incentive] First Day Companion Interaction Reward Callout: Add an interactive reward badge on the final intro screen encouraging immediate first desktop interaction.
   config: {"home_intro": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Click your pet on the desktop to claim your starter toy!", "style": "playful"}]}}
9: [home, notification] Background Pet Spawn Ready Desktop Alert: Enable desktop readiness notifications on the waiting screen so users can minimize the app while pet generation completes.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "Feel free to work on other tasks. We will alert you when your pet lands on your desktop!"}}

verdicts.reason: Adding account restoration hint on sign-in screen is allowed within onboarding.
Redesigning waiting screen with real-time progress and tips maintains its function.
Split layout for pick_friend screen maintains the selection functionality.
Adding a controls intro screen before home_intro is allowed inside onboarding.
Reordering sign_in after adoption certificate is explicitly permitted by Rule 4.
Displaying time estimate and notification settings on waiting screen is allowed.
Updating choose_path screen layout is an allowed onboarding design change.
Adding photo upload guidelines copy is allowed.
Onboarding copy mentions gifts or free extras ('starter toy').
Adding desktop readiness notifications to the waiting screen is allowed.
